_comment: Copy to configs/assist.json (gitignored) to turn on the free vision-model second opinion.
Keys are never written here: set GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY and/or OPENROUTER_API_KEY
in .env or the service environment. Use keys from accounts with NO billing attached
(a Google AI Studio project without billing, a Groq free plan, an OpenRouter account
with no credits): a free-tier key cannot run up a bill, whatever happens here.
Pictures of people are sent to the provider. Free tiers may use them to improve their
models; heads are blurred first (blur_heads). Read the provider's terms first.
Budget: at most per_window questions per playground every window_minutes, and each
provider is held to half its free daily limit (assist/budget.py).
